admission.justification: Converted templates alone cannot reach adoption without a writable measured fixer, the adoption gate alone cannot create anchors, and valid cards/baseline alone cannot truthfully claim foundation state; all five obligations form the fresh-setup guarantee.

guarantee: A new repository reaches an attributed first baseline with converted anchored onboarding through the existing authority-measured fixer, and the ordered setup/handoff never treats those cards or that baseline as a knowledge foundation.
title: converted-first-baseline-with-truthful-handoff
